svg.title: A Language Users Can Speak
svg.desc: Sketch in perspective: two mannequins stand facing each other, one nearer the viewer and one farther back, and talk. Both speech bubbles hold the same simple picture of two crossed keys; the nearer figure's bubble is hatched. On the ground between them sits a thick binder, closed. The figures are members of a group that runs a system together; neither is drawn as an expert. The crossed keys are a pattern's plain name, here Two Keyholders, turned into a picture: something anyone can say. The hatched bubble is the solution working, the focus: a member using the name in ordinary conversation. The same picture in the second bubble shows it understood and used back, the consequence that pattern names become the group's words. The closed binder is the technical detail, such as commands, tools, and configuration, which the solution keeps in the Actions and guides rather than in the name. The metaphor: pattern names as everyday words in a shared language, with the manual nearby but closed.
